visual.name: bfusionCapacityPlanning
visual.description: Combo chart (grouped bars + lines) with data table and insights sidebar for capacity planning. Measures: Capacity, Scheduled, Committed, Actuals, Forecast. Supports Hours/FTE toggle and timeline drill-down.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Time axis — supports Year > Quarter > Month > Week drill hierarchy.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

chartHeightRatio.description: Portion of visual height used by the chart (0.2 – 0.9).

displayUnit.description: Show values in Hours or FTE.

fteHoursPerPeriod.description: Hours that equal 1 FTE for the selected time grain (e.g. 40 for weekly, 160 for monthly).

capacityInputUnit.description: Unit of the Capacity measure in the source model. Auto-detect compares the magnitude against Hours-per-FTE.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.

legendFontSize.description: Font size of the legend bar above the chart.

axisFontSize.description: Font size of the chart's X and Y axis labels.

tableHeaderFontSize.description: Font size of the data-table column headers.

tableBodyFontSize.description: Font size of the data-table values.

insightLabelFontSize.description: Font size of the small ALL-CAPS labels in the insight panel.

insightValueFontSize.description: Font size of the KPI values and status text in the insight panel.

tooltipFontSize.description: Font size of the on-hover tooltip.
